method: Independent exact arithmetic and numerical checks; assumptions stated explicitly.
explanation: Analytic construction: each boundary arc has radius w and center at its opposite vertex. In every normal sector one support point is such a vertex and the opposite support point is on that vertex-centered arc, separated by w along the normal. Sector boundaries follow by continuity. Max polygon sampling width error 0.000019462, not a claim that numeric sampling proves constancy. Fixed rails at ±w/2; translating to center the horizontal supports does not alter width.
